Definition: Dodo, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Dodo was the name of three Israelites: the father of Eleazar, one of David's mighty men; the father of another mighty man; and the father of Tola, the judge who arose after Abimelech. The name means beloved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three Dodos are kept apart in the record by their sons, because God knows which man is which. A father is remembered by the son he raised, and the mighty men by the father who named them.
